item.title: 【Cinema Center】SERIES - My Parents Are Aliens (1999) Series 1-6 Web-DL H265
item.description:
Hello everybody! Here is a classic British Children's sitcom!

I have taken the original webrip for series 1-6 of this show (I dont believe 7-8 has a webrip) and made some changes.

Series 1 is in 4:3 ratio and the 16:9 animated intro/outro had been shrunk down to fit the 4:3 size so I made them fullscreen and upscaled it. I also cropped out the mess around the sides of the episodes.

Series 2-6 had big horrible uneven fading black bars at the sides and small ones at the top and bottom. I've cropped them out and set the metadata to show the episode in 16:9. VLC player will show the episode in fullscreen but some players like the default windows one wont show it in fullscreen by default so I recommend using VLC!

S03E05 had no subtitles so I created some for it. I've not made subtitles before, so If you're a subtitle user let me know if they are any good!
